description: This file contains implementation of arbitrary-precision number routines including addition, multiplication, division, remainder, and comparison functions, for a project related to number support in the 'ratpak' package.

methods.name: addnum
methods.description: Adds a number b to the number pointed to by pa, modifying pa in place.

methods.name: _addnum
methods.description: Performs the core addition of two arbitrary-precision numbers, handling sign and carry.

methods.name: mulnum
methods.description: Multiplies the number pointed to by pa by number b, modifying pa in place.

methods.name: _mulnum
methods.description: Performs the core multiplication of two arbitrary-precision numbers.

methods.name: remnum
methods.description: Computes the remainder of *pa divided by b, modifying *pa.

methods.name: _divnum
methods.description: Performs the core division of two arbitrary-precision numbers with specified precision.

methods.name: equnum
methods.description: Checks if two numbers are equal.

methods.name: zernum
methods.description: Checks if a number is zero.
